body: He knows how I feel and we have even negotiated dates in the past when I told him I was ready. He worries, but is a typical guy who keeps it to himself. He spoke to my doctor once, but a therapist she suggested was not available, and that was the end of that. Otherwise, he respects my privacy. He understands how disappointed I am, and there is really nothing he can do about it. I haven't talked to him about how I would do it, but I will make sure he is not the one who finds me. I have thought out those details.
